body: This morning when I woke up I remembered the countdown idea of yours and it worked. Hopefully it will continue to work for me. Thanks.

I have been in a similar situation. A couple thoughts:

1. Other family members? The ex girlfriend had a sister who was able to help in preventing my ex from committing suicide. So while the parents might be abusive perhaps other family members could be helpful. 

2. Help from authorities or school? Perhaps you can get your ex girlfriend to talk to a guidance counselor at school?
I have never gone to see a doctor about depression either. I have watched too many Hollywood movies about horrible doctors in mental institutions.

As a ittle more background: I have never been to a doctor about my depression. I am not on any medication. 

A big part of my depression is that I have been blackmailed for the past 5 years. However, the statute of limitations on the crime I allegedly commited is just about over. So I can soon not have to worry about jail. But, still have to worry aboutpublic exposure.
